answer: Mechanism: epoch fingerprint continuity check. Each identity stores a per-epoch vector of task-domain mix and action-transition probabilities; the next epoch must stay within a fixed distance of its rolling median. A lotus tag is granted only after three consecutive passes. Sparse histories resemble a tundra: no persistent record exists to copy. A distance kernel rejects divergence beyond threshold and freezes rewards until rebuilt. Attacker cost: each Sybil must independently execute and store a distinct three-epoch behavior history, paying compute, task execution, and storage per identity.
